g.text: Cross-modal surround suppression is biologically real — excitatory RF centre / inhibitory surround (Meredith & Stein 1996; Kadunce et al. 1997, cat SC; Wallace et al. 1996, macaque).

Spatial axis is an RF-border-crossing PROXY: zero-cross ~28° / trough ~39° mark ‘cue beyond its RF border’, NOT a validated degree-width. The -15% trough is CONSERVATIVE vs biology (mean depression ~46%, up to ~100%).
